about: FM-1 Pocket Player publishing policy. A firmware is published only if its id is in `approved` and its licence (as the .rfm1 states it) is unchanged. New ids, and approved ids whose licence changes, wait for review: the nightly job opens a 'pocket-review' issue; add the 'approved' label to accept it. `excluded` ids are never published or requested. `smokeExceptions` documents why a firmware may skip one part of the boot test.

emuNotes.about: Firmwares that are silent in the emulator's scripted session for a known reason (pocket/emu/catalog.py): kept experimental with this reason, never counted as a failure.
emuNotes.sidj: Its original package ships with no songs: they are sent over USB from its web page (thomasj.github.io/fm1-sidj), which neither player can do. The .rfm1 build carries songs of its own.
emuNotes.beetle: A tracker: nothing plays until a song is written or loaded.
emuNotes.beetleblue: A drum tracker: nothing plays until a pattern is written.
emuNotes.lsdjburrito: Plays only an LSDJ song sent over USB from its web page, which neither player can do.
emuNotes.dubbox: Processes audio coming in over USB or Bluetooth; neither player has an audio input.
emuNotes.audiorouter: Processes audio coming in over USB or Bluetooth; neither player has an audio input.
emuNotes.midimon: A MIDI monitor: it shows MIDI, it does not make sound.
emuNotes.vibe-link: Upstream fm1-emu holds it back: it shows its own crash screen a second or two after boot.

emuPrefer.about: Per firmware, the engine both players use first whatever the measurements say, with why (pocket/emu/catalog.py). The listener can still choose the other.

hortator.reason: The .rfm1 build is used first until a listening test confirms the original package in the app (its pattern starts empty, so PLAY is silent until steps are entered).

knownIssues.about: Known problems per firmware and engine (fm1-emu or rfm1), shown as such in both players and kept apart from automated checks and listening tests. Listening reports with problems add to these automatically (pocket/emu/listening.json).

hortator.fm1-emu: Starts with an empty pattern: PLAY is silent until steps are entered on the keys.

sidj.fm1-emu: The original package has no songs: they are sent over USB from the maker's page, which the players cannot do.
